items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: I went with Ted Weems periodically... he would tell me to come to Columbus and sit in

ctx.x: And you went back with Ted Weems for a while, in the midwest or just wherever...
Yeah, well I went with Ted Weems periodically. If he were in Pittsburgh and I was in Columbus, Ohio, he would tell me to come to Columbus and sit in, you know because he loved me.
And you were in that situation when Russ Morgan contacted you about going to the Goldkette Band?
